name: Wisp 0.5.0
notes:
• In-app update checks with release notes, a non-nagging prompt, Later and Skip this version.
• Update manifest hosted with GitHub; no custom update server and no account.
• Android update prompts open the signed APK download; Windows opens the installer download.
• Manual Check for updates in Settings → About on both platforms.
• The browser link, Ask Wisp voice commands, Files search, media players and QR temporary link remain.
